newsitem.title: USA: Biocontrol says in talks with FDA.
newsitem.headline: Biocontrol says in talks with FDA.

text.p: Biocontrol Technology Inc said Wednesday it is continuing discussions with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to finalize an agreement to conduct an in-home study on its Diasensor 1000 noninvasive glucose sensor for diabetics.

"Once the details are worked out, the company will commence the study," Biocontrol Chief Executive Fred Cooper said in a statement. "Although there are no guarantees, it is our hope that this study can be done in a timely fashion."
Two weeks ago, the FDA asked for another study before giving market approval for the product. The company said Wednesday that once the study is completed, it plans to resubmit its application.
